parameters.query:
SET search_path TO inventario;

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')::DATE AS mes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.id)                    AS total_ventas,
    SUM(dv.cantidad)                        AS unidades_vendidas,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.total), 0)              AS ingresos_totales,
    COALESCE(AVG(v.total), 0)              AS ticket_promedio,
    (SELECT nombre FROM productos p
     JOIN detalle_venta d ON d.producto_id = p.id
     JOIN ventas vv ON vv.id = d.venta_id
     WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', vv.fecha) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
     GROUP BY p.nombre
     ORDER BY SUM(d.cantidad) DESC
     LIMIT 1)                              AS producto_estrella
FROM ventas v
JOIN detalle_venta dv ON dv.venta_id = v.id
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', v.fecha) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month');
